37	      { "block_id": "block_03", "block_type": "headline line", "position": "Top center, under the pill", "visual_function": "Bridges to the key word", "adaptation_rule": "Big white uppercase heavy sans with soft shadow", "present_in_reference": true },
38	      { "block_id": "block_04", "block_type": "headline accent word", "position": "Top center, under the white line, full width", "visual_function": "Scroll-stopping key word", "adaptation_rule": "Huge fuchsia uppercase word with thick white outline and drop shadow", "present_in_reference": true },

40	      { "block_id": "block_06", "block_type": "product", "position": "Center-left, middle band, large and upright", "visual_function": "Hero product", "adaptation_rule": "The user's bottle exactly as in the attached photo", "present_in_reference": true },

44	      { "block_id": "block_10", "block_type": "offer bar", "position": "Bottom, from the left edge to about two thirds of the width", "visual_function": "Removes payment risk", "adaptation_rule": "Deep magenta rounded bar with white truck icon + label, thin white vertical divider, white hand-with-coin icon + two-line label", "present_in_reference": true },

58	  "visual_prompt": "Square 1:1 premium beauty-supplement image ad. Use the attached reference only for its layout, block placement, hierarchy and typography, and the attached product photo as the only source of truth for the product: do not redesign, replace or reinterpret the bottle, and do not copy any brand, product or text from the reference. Background: glossy pink gradient, bubblegum pink #FF8CC0 to hot fuchsia #E6177F at the edges with a soft pale blush #FBE3EE glow in the center, faint translucent pink petal shapes and thin heart outlines in the top corners. Neto 30g)' at the bottom; sharp, soft studio light, small contact shadow. At the lower left of the bottle: real aguaje fruits (reddish-brown scaly whole fruits and one halved fruit showing bright orange flesh, #D9572B) with a few fresh green leaves. Above the bottle, to its right, a two-line handwritten brush script accent in deep magenta with a small drawn heart. On the right side, a tall rounded-corner photo frame with a thin white border, from just under the headline to just above the bottom bar: a photorealistic photo of a young Colombian woman with brown skin and curly black hair tied up in a bun, seen from behind and slightly from below, wearing a matching pink athletic set (high-waisted leggings and sports top), walking with a natural stride on a sunny terrace with green potted plants, framed from the shoulders down to the knees, natural athletic curves in glutes and legs, real skin texture, tasteful and non-explicit, face not shown. BOTTOM BAND: a deep magenta #B0105E rounded bar from the left edge to about two thirds of the width, with a white delivery-truck line icon and a white uppercase label, a thin white vertical divider, then a white hand-holding-a-coin line icon and a two-line white uppercase label. In the bottom right corner, outside the bar, a two-line handwritten brush script accent in deep magenta with a small drawn heart. Everything clean, high contrast and readable on a phone. No other elements.",

60	    { "block_id": "text_block_01", "reference_function": "headline pill line", "reference_position": "Top center, inside the deep magenta rounded pill", "text_style": "White, uppercase, heavy geometric sans (Montserrat Black look), medium-large, centered", "text": "SIÉNTETE SEGURA" },

64	    { "block_id": "text_block_05", "reference_function": "benefit icon label 1", "reference_position": "Left column, under the first icon (glute silhouette)", "text_style": "White, uppercase, bold geometric sans, small, centered, two lines", "text": "GLÚTEOS\nMÁS FIRMES" },
65	    { "block_id": "text_block_06", "reference_function": "benefit icon label 2", "reference_position": "Left column, under the second icon (leg silhouette)", "text_style": "White, uppercase, bold geometric sans, small, centered, two lines", "text": "PIERNAS\nCON MÁS VOLUMEN" },
66	    { "block_id": "text_block_07", "reference_function": "benefit icon label 3", "reference_position": "Left column, under the third icon (leaf)", "text_style": "White, uppercase, bold geometric sans, small, centered, two lines", "text": "FÓRMULA\nNATURAL" },
67	    { "block_id": "text_block_08", "reference_function": "offer bar label 1", "reference_position": "Bottom bar, left part, right of the truck icon", "text_style": "White, uppercase, heavy geometric sans, medium, one line", "text": "ENVÍO GRATIS" },
68	    { "block_id": "text_block_09", "reference_function": "offer bar label 2", "reference_position": "Bottom bar, right part, right of the hand-with-coin icon", "text_style": "White, uppercase, heavy geometric sans, medium, two lines", "text": "PAGA\nAL RECIBIR" },
69	    { "block_id": "text_block_10", "reference_function": "closing script accent", "reference_position": "Bottom right corner, right of the offer bar", "text_style": "Handwritten brush script, deep magenta #B0105E, sentence case, two lines, slight tilt, small drawn heart", "text": "Natural,\na tu ritmo" }
70	  ],
71	  "mandatory_visual_elements": [
72	    "Glossy pink gradient background with faint petal and heart outline shapes",
73	    "Deep magenta rounded headline pill",
74	    "Huge fuchsia headline word with thick white outline and drop shadow",
75	    "Three white thin-line icons in white-outlined circles in the left column (glute silhouette, leg silhouette, leaf)",
76	    "The user's black bottle with hot-pink cap and base, identical to the product photo",
77	    "Real aguaje fruits, one halved with orange flesh, with green leaves at the base of the bottle",
78	    "Tall rounded-corner photo frame with thin white border showing a woman from behind",
79	    "Deep magenta rounded bottom bar with white truck icon, thin divider and white hand-with-coin icon",
80	    "Two handwritten script accents with small drawn hearts"
81	  ],
82	  "final_generation_exclusions": [
83	    "No brand logo or brand name other than what is printed on the product label; do not copy the reference brand, bottle or texts.",
84	    "No price, discount, stars, ratings, testimonials, certification seals or medals.",
85	    "No nudity, no explicit or sexualized pose; no visible face of the woman.",
86	    "Do not add any visual module that is not described in this prompt.",
87	    "Do not add any text that is not listed in the EXACT VISIBLE TEXT section.",
88	    "Do not add CTA buttons, prices, badges, benefits, icons, trust seals, ratings, testimonials, bottom bars, discount labels, offer boxes or extra claims unless they are explicitly listed in detected_visual_blocks or text_layers.",
89	    "Preserve the translated structure exactly. Do not complete or improve the layout with additional advertising elements."
90	  ],
91	  "meta_policy_check": "All visible text has been sanitized for Facebook/Instagram Ads compliance. No prohibited claims, no false guarantees and no direct personal attribute callouts.",
92	  "language_rule": "All visible text inside the generated image must be written in Spanish."
93	}
